name: app-client-vision-quote-slide-with-rounded-portrait
title: Client vision quote with bold phrases and rounded portrait
whatItIs: A light grey slide with a rounded portrait of a curly-haired man at left and a large quote in light grey type where key phrases are dark bold. Name and title are below.
whatItMeans: Human, credible and clear; the bolded phrases summarise the quote at a glance.
techniques: Bold selected phrases within a light quote so it can be skimmed.
Pair a rounded-corner portrait with a paragraph.
Use a small dot and section title at the top corner as a header.

vocabulary.definition: Bold phrases inside light text for quick reading.
A photo with softly rounded corners.
A dot and label denoting a slide's topic.
Name and role beneath a quote.
